result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor content issue.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated and cut off, suggesting the card layout is not properly handling text overflow or the card width is too narrow.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant name text either wraps to a second line, uses an ellipsis with a tooltip, or the card width is adjusted to accommodate typical restaurant name lengths.

issues.description: The last visible restaurant card at the bottom of the screen shows a '-0%' discount badge, which appears to be a data or formatting error since a 0% discount is meaningless and the minus sign makes it look like a bug.
issues.suggestion: Only display discount badges when there is an actual non-zero discount. Filter out or hide badges with 0% values.
